paragraphs: R. Yudan of Tzaydin: end of Yevamot and Kiddushin. [The checked Rif on Yevamot names Abba Yudan of Tzaydan. The closest checked Kiddushin passage has Abba Guryan of Tzaydan.] Tosefta Ohalot, chapter 18: Abba Yudan of Sidon in R. Eliezer's name.
